definition: A formula that turns a conditional probability round: it finds $\mathrm{P}(B \mid A)$ from $\mathrm{P}(B)$ and the chances of $A$ on every first-stage branch.
A set of events, such as $B_1$, $B_2$ and $B_3$, where exactly one happens on each trial: they are mutually exclusive and their probabilities add up to $1$.
